title: Hybrid multi-objective metaheuristic algorithms for solving airline crew rostering problem with qualification and language.
problem: The rational allocation of crew members is a strategy to alleviate crew scarcity, but without an appropriate allocation plan, some flights may be canceled due to a lack of pilots in the scheduling period.
contribution: We propose the design of two hybrid metaheuristic algorithms based on a genetic algorithm, variable neighborhood search algorithm and the Aquila optimizer to face the trade-off between fairness and crew satisfaction.
method: We propose the design of two hybrid metaheuristic algorithms based on a genetic algorithm, variable neighborhood search algorithm and the Aquila optimizer.
results: The simulation results show that our approach preserves the fairness of the system and maximizes the fairness at the cost of crew satisfaction.
